scope: Grammar correction, context-preserving paraphrase, IELTS question sources, spoken chunks and collocation references; excludes audio/transcript collection
notes: Reported counts are publisher figures, not locally counted imports.
Decisions are project recommendations, not additional permissions.
Data text, software licenses and model licenses are distinct.
No linked corpus has been downloaded or used to train a model in this task.

sources.name: W&I+LOCNESS / BEA-2019
sources.license_observed: Non-commercial purposes only according to shared-task organizer
limitations: Writing domain, not IELTS speaking
Standardized error types include automatic ERRANT annotation
No Indonesian explanation layer

sources.name: JFLEG
sources.use: Alternative acceptable corrections and written naturalness
limitations: Fluency in this corpus is text naturalness, not spoken temporal fluency
Corrections may exceed minimal edits

sources.name: CoEdIT public release
sources.license_observed: Dataset card: Apache-2.0; composite underlying-corpus provenance requires review
sources.use: Generate candidate GEC and paraphrase edits
limitations: Writing-assistance domain
Public release omits some simplification/formality material for licensing reasons
No guarantee of minimal edits or preservation of tone/intensity
Do not assume card metadata resolves all underlying corpus rights

sources.name: PAWS-Wiki Labeled Final
sources.license_observed: Repository custom license permits any purpose; Google source acknowledgement appreciated
sources.use: Detect high lexical overlap with changed meaning
limitations: Label 0 is not a valid positive rewrite target
Wikipedia domain, not conversational learner feedback
Exclude PAWS-QQP from this decision; QQP has separate source restrictions
Not a measure of register, idiom suitability or IELTS band

sources.name: CWEB
sources.use: Check unnecessary edits in low-error text
limitations: Website domain
No Indonesian explanations or speaking labels

sources.name: C4_200M synthetic GEC edits
sources.license_observed: CC BY 4.0 specifically for corruption edits; C4 text acquired separately
limitations: Must reconstruct parallel data with C4
Edit license is not blanket clearance of source web text
Synthetic errors may not match Indonesian learner speech

sources.name: ERRANT
sources.use: Align existing original/corrected pairs and assign error types
limitations: Does not establish whether the correction is correct
Does not supply Indonesian pedagogical explanations
Tool, not source learner corpus

sources.name: IELTS.org Speaking Sample Tasks
sources.license_observed: Personal/noncommercial website material; permission required for other stated uses
sources.use: Part 1/2/3 blueprint and linked Part 2-3 structure
limitations: Sample questions, not an exhaustive public active-exam bank
No production republication permission established

sources.name: British Council Speaking practice
sources.license_observed: Public practice access; production question reuse permission not established
sources.use: Official practice and links to further preparation
limitations: Extra IELTS Ready access may depend on account/booking
Counts of practice tests across skills are not Speaking-only set counts

sources.name: IDP IELTS Speaking practice tests
sources.license_observed: Website reproduction/storage restricted without appropriate permission or statutory basis
limitations: Do not mix IELTS Life Skills A1/A2/B1 with IELTS Speaking Part 1-3

sources.name: IELTS Liz Part 1 Topics and Questions
sources.license_observed: No open bulk/product reuse license established
sources.use: Broader topic coverage and teacher examples
limitations: Not an official IELTS question bank or prediction guarantee
Comments from test takers are separate unverified recall

sources.name: IELTS Advantage question collection
sources.license_observed: No open bulk/product reuse license established
limitations: Not an official active-exam bank
Public PDF access is not redistribution permission

sources.name: Cambridge English Grammar Today: Spoken English
sources.license_observed: Reference only; no bulk extraction license established
sources.use: Chunks, ellipsis, hedges and spoken interaction
limitations: Do not copy dictionary examples/definitions into a bulk bank

sources.name: Cambridge English Grammar Today: Discourse markers
sources.license_observed: Reference only; no bulk extraction license established
limitations: Speaking and writing register differ
Marker counts are not a fluency score

sources.name: Oxford OPAL spoken phrases
sources.license_observed: No product database extraction permission established
limitations: Includes lecture signposting, not every phrase suits learner conversation/IELTS

sources.name: Cambridge English Grammar Today: Collocation
sources.license_observed: Reference only; no bulk extraction license established
sources.use: Check word combinations and common collocation problems
limitations: Not a downloaded open collocation dataset

sources.name: British Council Phrasal verbs B1-B2
sources.license_observed: Reference only; no bulk lesson reuse permission established
limitations: Lesson level is not a verified CEFR label for every phrase

sources.license_observed: Reference only; no bulk lesson reuse permission established
limitations: Lesson level is not a verified CEFR label for every phrase
